topic: Separating Mixtures Using Filtering and Sieving
key_concepts: Mixtures can be separated by physical means
Filtration removes suspended solids from a liquid using a porous material
In filtration, the liquid that passes through the filter is called the filtrate
In filtration, the solid that remains on the filter paper is called the residue
Filter paper or cloth can be used as the filter medium
Sieving separates particles of different sizes using a sieve
Sieves have holes that allow smaller particles to pass while retaining larger particles
Filtration is used in everyday life such as making coffee and removing tea leaves from hot
Sieving is used to separate dry mixtures like sand and gravel
Sieving can separate flour from seeds or pebbles
Faucet filters use filtering to remove solid impurities from water
Sieving is a time-saving method for separating particles of different sizes
